view_profile: Visit the lead's profile. Creates a 'viewed your profile' notification — free brand exposure.
view_profile_repeat: View profile on 3 separate days. Creates repeated visibility without being creepy. Name sticks.
follow_profile: Follow the lead's public profile. Creates a follow notification. Also makes your own posts visible to them.
like_post: Like the lead's most recent post. Name recognition before connecting. Run 2-3 days before connection request.
like_top_3_posts: Like the 3 most recent posts over 3 days. Multiple engagement signals — looks completely human.
react_insightful: React 'Insightful' on their latest post. Signals you actually read the content — more intentional than a Like.
react_celebrate: React 'Celebrate' — ideal for job announcements, promotions, company milestones. Very personal.
comment_on_post: Leave a comment on their most recent post. 5× more visible than a like. Almost nobody automates this — it looks completely genuine.
endorse_skill: Endorse one of the lead's top skills. Creates a strong notification. Rarely done by anyone — highly noticed.
endorse_3_skills: Endorse their top 3 skills in sequence. Three separate notifications — they'll remember your name.
follow_company: Follow the lead's company LinkedIn page. Signals you researched them, not just scraped them.
congratulate_new_job: Fires when lead changed jobs in last 90 days. Best cold opener that exists — people always reply to congrats.
congratulate_anniversary: Fires on their work anniversary. LinkedIn shows these prominently — high reply rate from this trigger.
share_post: Share the lead's recent post to your network. Highest form of engagement. They always get notified — almost nobody automates this.
invite_to_event: Invite the lead to a LinkedIn Event you're hosting. A warm-up that delivers massive value and name recognition before you connect.
connection_request: Send a personalised connection request (300 chars). LinkedIn limits notes on non-premium — fallback sends without note.
connection_no_note: Send a blank connection request — no note. Sometimes converts better than a note on mobile. Test both.
connection_ai_note: AI reads their profile + recent posts and writes a hyper-personalized 300-char connection note. 15-20% higher acceptance vs generic notes.
withdraw_request: Auto-withdraw a connection request that's been pending for N days. Keeps your pending queue clean and avoids LinkedIn spam flags.
remove_connection: Remove a 1st-degree connection. Used to clean bad-fit contacts post-campaign or after they opted out.
if_connected: Did the lead accept your connection request? Branches into Connected and Not connected paths.
if_replied: Did the lead reply to any of your messages? Routes to separate follow-up path if no reply.
if_replied_positive: AI detects positive sentiment in the reply. Routes warm leads to booking path immediately.
if_replied_negative: AI detects rejection or 'not interested' reply. Routes to opt-out sequence and suppress future campaigns.
if_replied_neutral: Lead replied but didn't commit. 'Tell me more', 'Maybe', 'Not right now'. Needs a different nurture path.
if_email_found: Did enrichment return a verified email? Branch to email handoff if found, continue LinkedIn if not.
if_phone_found: Did enrichment return a direct dial or mobile? Route to SDR call path.
open_profile_check: Is the lead open to InMail without a connection? If yes, skip the connection step entirely — saves time and credits.
if_premium_member: Does the lead have LinkedIn Premium or Sales Navigator? Signals budget and seriousness — often worth a more direct approach.
if_mutual_connections: Do you share ≥N mutual connections? Mutual connections dramatically increase connection acceptance and message replies.
if_recently_active: Was the lead active on LinkedIn in the last N days? Inactive leads waste your message quota. Skip or deprioritize.
if_has_recent_posts: Has the lead posted in the last N days? Active posters have much higher reply rates and give you comment-based warm-up material.
if_company_size: Is the lead's company headcount within your ICP range? Filter SMB vs Mid-Market vs Enterprise before spending messages.
if_title_matches: Does the lead's title contain your target keywords? Pre-qualify before connecting to avoid wasting warm-up steps.
if_location_matches: Is the lead based in your target geography? Critical for local outreach or timezone-aware sequences.
if_industry_matches: Is the lead in your target industry? Branch to industry-specific messaging when matched.
if_company_hiring: Does the company have open job postings? Hiring = growth = budget. Route hiring companies to a more aggressive close.
icp_score_gate: Multi-factor ICP scoring: title match + company size + industry + funding + activity. Only advance leads above your threshold — don't waste premium steps on bad fits.
if_meeting_booked: Check if the lead clicked your Calendly link and booked. Stops all follow-ups immediately upon booking — no double-booking embarrassment.
if_request_pending: Is the connection request still sitting unanswered after N days? Routes to InMail, withdraw, or alternate path.
send_message: Send a LinkedIn DM to a 1st-degree connection. Supports variable insertion and message versions.
send_ai_message: AI reads the lead's profile, job title, company, and most recent post to write a unique first-line hook. Then appends your template. Highest reply rates in outreach today.
send_message_ab: Split test 3 message variants on the same audience. Automatically picks the winner after N replies and routes all future leads to it.
send_voice_note: Send a LinkedIn voice message. 3× higher reply rate than text — almost nobody does this at scale. Use for high-value leads after connection.
send_inmail: Send a LinkedIn InMail — works without a connection. Requires Sales Navigator or premium credits. For high-value leads who won't accept connections.
send_paid_inmail: Uses sponsored InMail credits — guaranteed delivery to any LinkedIn member, connected or not. Use for highest-value accounts only.
send_message_with_doc: Attach a PDF (case study, deck, one-pager) to your DM. Proven to increase engagement on LinkedIn — lead can open without leaving the platform.
send_intro_message: Auto-fires 1-2 hours after the lead accepts your connection. Strike while they're warm — intro messages sent right after connecting have 40% reply rates.
send_followup: Follow-up message after no reply. Day 3-5 after initial message. Keep it short. One sentence, one question.
send_breakup_message: The 'I'll leave you alone after this' message. Paradoxically the highest reply rate in any sequence — people reply because they feel bad. Use as your last step.
send_reengage_message: Lead went cold after initial replies. Fire 60-90 days later with a fresh angle. New job? New pain? New trigger. Treat them like a new lead.
send_message_with_image: Attach a custom image (ROI chart, comparison slide, meme) to your DM. Stops the scroll in the inbox preview. Use for mid-sequence re-engagement.
ai_personalize: Reads the lead's profile: job title, company, recent posts, mutual connections, bio. Generates a unique personalization variable {{ai_hook}} for use in any message.
ai_detect_sentiment: Reads the lead's reply message and classifies it: Positive (wants to talk) / Negative (not interested) / Neutral (needs more info). Routes to the correct branch automatically.
ai_generate_icebreaker: Reads their most recent LinkedIn post and writes a hyper-specific comment or opener referencing it. Best way to start a conversation that doesn't feel like outreach.
ai_translate_message: Detect the lead's language from their profile/posts and auto-translate your message. For EU and LATAM outreach — native-language messages get 2× more replies.
ai_score_icp: AI reads the full profile and scores lead-to-ICP fit on 0-100. More nuanced than rule-based scoring — understands context, growth signals, pain indicators.
ai_buying_signal: Scans the lead's last 10 posts for buying signals: mentions of scaling, growth, pain points your service solves. High-signal leads get a different, more direct path.
ai_write_connection_note: AI writes the 300-char connection note using their profile data. Avoids 'I'd like to add you to my network' garbage. Personalized to their specific role and company.
ai_summarize_profile: Generates an internal 'lead intel card' — role, company context, likely pain points, suggested approach. Saved to the lead record for your team's reference.
ai_detect_competitor: Is this lead already using a direct competitor? Detects from profile bio, experience, posts. If yes, route to a comparison-based message track, not a cold intro.
ai_best_send_time: Analyzes when the lead posts and is active on LinkedIn. Delays your message to the optimal send window. Increases open rate by 20-30%.
find_email: Waterfall enrichment: Apollo → Hunter → Clearbit → Snov. Returns verified work email or empty. 1 credit per enriched lead.
find_personal_email: Enriches personal/private email (Gmail, Outlook). Used for founder-led outreach where work email bounces. PDL + Apollo fallback.
find_phone: Enrich mobile/direct-dial from Apollo or PDL. Use for phone-based follow-up after LinkedIn engagement.
find_company_url: Resolve the company LinkedIn page URL from the lead's profile. Required for company-page engagement actions.
find_company_website: Extract the company's website URL. Used for tech-stack detection, personalization, and CRM enrichment.
find_tech_stack: Clearbit Reveal / BuiltWith lookup. What tools does their company use? Routes to tool-specific messaging (e.g., 'I see you're on Salesforce...').
find_funding_round: Crunchbase lookup. Did the company recently raise? Fresh funding = fresh budget = best time to pitch. Routes recently-funded leads to a priority path.
find_headcount: LinkedIn company page scrape for current employee count. Used to qualify SMB vs Mid-Market vs Enterprise before routing.
find_job_postings: Detects if the company is actively hiring and for what roles. Hiring signals = growth + budget. Routes hiring companies to a specific pitch angle.
get_linkedin_activity: How active is this person on LinkedIn? Posts/month, comments, reactions. Active users reply faster. Score the lead before deciding message cadence.
get_mutual_connections: Fetch the list of shared connections. Highest-value mutuals get surfaced for use in personalized openers ('We're both connected to {{mutual}}...').
verify_email: ZeroBounce / NeverBounce check on enriched email before handing off to cold email tools. Prevents bounce damage to your sending domain.
add_to_smartlead: Hand off LinkedIn-warmed lead to a Smartlead email campaign. LinkedIn warmed them — email closes them.
add_to_instantly: Hand off lead to an Instantly email campaign. Use after enrichment finds a verified email.
add_to_emailbison: Send lead to EmailBison — your internal cold email stack.
add_to_lemlist: Hand off to a Lemlist multi-channel sequence — email + LinkedIn + phone in one flow.
add_to_apollo: Enroll lead into an Apollo.io sequence for email + automated follow-up. Apollo's deliverability is strong for cold email.
push_to_hubspot: Create or update a HubSpot contact + deal. Set lifecycle stage, pipeline, and deal owner. Fires on positive reply or booking.
push_to_salesforce: Create Lead or Contact record in Salesforce. Assign to owner, set lead source as 'LinkedIn Campaign'. Routes to opportunity on booking.
push_to_pipedrive: Create contact + deal in Pipedrive. Move through pipeline stages based on sequence progress.
push_to_notion: Add lead as a record in your Notion CRM database. For lean teams managing pipeline in Notion.
push_to_airtable: Add or update lead in an Airtable base. Great for custom tracking, reporting, or team-shared deal boards.
send_slack_alert: Fire a Slack message to your sales channel when a lead replies, books, or triggers a key event. Real-time signal — reply within minutes of intent.
send_webhook: POST lead data to any endpoint — Zapier, Make, n8n, custom backend. Universal connector for anything not listed.
send_meeting_invite: Embed your Calendly / booking link in a message. Tracked — if lead books, all follow-ups stop automatically. No double-pinging someone who already booked.
send_intro_call_invite: Send a LinkedIn-native meeting request (free feature). Doesn't require a Calendly link — lead can accept or decline from LinkedIn directly.
mark_mql: Tag lead as Marketing Qualified. Pushes to sales team for follow-up. Triggers Slack alert + CRM update simultaneously.
mark_sql: Sales Qualified Lead — triggers immediate SDR notification. Highest priority status. Fires when lead confirms interest in a demo or proposal.
mark_converted: End the sequence and tag the lead as converted. Stops all future touches. Use after a booking, signed deal, or positive verbal.
mark_not_interested: Lead explicitly said no. Stop sequence, log reason, suppress from future campaigns for N months. Clean pipeline = better data.
mark_opted_out: Hard stop — never contact this lead again. GDPR compliant. Adds to global suppression list across all campaigns and LinkedIn accounts.
push_to_demo_pipeline: Creates a demo-stage deal in your CRM with the meeting date, lead data, and sequence history. SDR gets a full brief before the call.
ab_split: Split your audience equally between two sequence paths. Test different opening angles, messages, or cadences. Analytics shows which path converts better.
weighted_split: Route X% of leads down Path A, rest to Path B. Use for progressive roll-outs: test a new sequence on 10%, scale to 90% once it wins.
daily_limit_check: Check if today's LinkedIn action quota is full before firing. Prevents over-limit bans. Queues the action for tomorrow if limit is hit.
blacklist_check: Check if the lead is on your global suppression list before taking any action. Prevents contacting opted-out, converted, or competitor leads.
add_tag: Tag the lead with a custom label for CRM segmentation, reporting, and retargeting. Tags persist across campaigns.
sequence_end: Terminates this path. Define the exit reason so your analytics know exactly why each lead exited and which paths perform best.
